The selection panel has met and decided on the Australian JWOC team to compete in the 2025 Junior World Championships (JWOC), held in Trentino, Italy, from 26 June to 4 July.
2025 JWOC Team Selection first appeared on Orienteering Australia.
articles.title: 2025 JWOC Team Selection
